description: Ground-truth queries for evaluating Mini-JuriNex retrieval. Each query lists judgment IDs considered relevant based on the judgment's actual content. Candidates must not include this file content in any prompt.

queries.query: Inadmissibility of electronic evidence without Section 65B certificate
queries.relevance_notes: j_0007 (Anvar) is the foundational decision; j_0011 (Arjun Panditrao) clarifies and extends it; j_0004 (Suresh Patil, Bombay HC) applies the rule.

queries.query: Conversion of FIR from accident to murder under Section 302
queries.relevance_notes: j_0005 (Ramesh Chandra Bhatt) holds conversion valid via supplementary chargesheet; j_0009 (Rohit Sharma) addresses procedural safeguards required after conversion.

queries.query: Motive demolished by prosecution witness in circumstantial evidence case
queries.relevance_notes: j_0001 (Suresh Kumar) is directly on point — motive destroyed by prosecution's own witness in a circumstantial evidence case led to acquittal.

queries.query: Quashing of criminal proceedings arising from matrimonial or commercial disputes
queries.relevance_notes: j_0008 (Priya Singh) addresses quashing of matrimonial 498A after settlement; j_0012 (Vikas Deshmukh) addresses quashing of commercial disputes cloaked as criminal complaints. Both invoke Section 482 CrPC.

queries.query: Rebuttal of statutory presumption in dowry death cases
queries.relevance_notes: j_0003 (Kavita Sharma) addresses rebuttal of the Section 113B IEA presumption in dowry death cases.
